component_rows.item: FG floor-truss joint gusset pair (floor structure for the 3 kPa classroom load, needed whether or not the module is lifted) - 1.5 mm G450, 3 + 3 screws per face
BR truss bridging - C89 0.95 nogging at mid-span, 2 screws each end
CL truss-end cleat pair - folded 1.5 mm G450 50 x 50 angle, full depth 280 mm, each side of the truss end; 5 screws into the end vertical, 5 into the edge-truss chords (3 bottom, 2 top)

CR cradle - two 3 mm G450 cheeks 120 x 200 over the joint gusset plates, 2 x M16 8.8 bearing bolts + 92 mm sleeves under the truss joints, 3 x 40 x 89 packers, strap bolts below the bearing bolts; screwed at the first joint, bearing only at the second
GU joint gusset pair (lift) - 1.5 mm G450 plate each face, 100 high, 3 + 3 screws per face per joint, flush with the chord face

LH lifting head - closed box: two 3 mm G450 cheeks 120 x 480 over the roof edge truss (no fasteners, stop block along the module), two 3 mm end plates above the truss, open top; M20 8.8 pin + 40 mm sleeve
HS hanger strap pair - 2 x 50 x 2.5 G450, one on each face, match-drilled, 2 x M12 8.8 each end with washers; fixed nowhere between its ends
PB floor / roof plane bracing strap - 30 x 1.0 G300 with tensioner
T2-T3 tie plate - 40 x 1.0 / 30 x 0.8 G300 strap on the side face across a joint, 4 + 4 / 2 + 2 screws
